question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19d7235edfc8b893ffbd91d371f639fd633538253748916a40f26ae93eaa02ca.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 
• **The characters are moving in clockwise direction i.e., towards right.**
 
• **At every step there is a new character is added such that, ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17e06ac23c4f56302eb2fcf4ea907c3726494bbea9de6e0759d859f513f9c481.png] ** replaces 'C', 'solid triangle' replaces 'rectangle', 'circle' replaces 'solid circle', 'block' replaces '** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4aa760da1ff4b1c2f2db85ccbcca310ca79cb081f866cb34616aa854f95d48cf.png] **', and at last, 'letter '** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34e716211f1b1eacb26640c1417b5796114f6789161defdd93c1f662a519f60c.png] **' replaces '** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17e06ac23c4f56302eb2fcf4ea907c3726494bbea9de6e0759d859f513f9c481.png] **'.**

**​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e40e7ba3841ab40da498d7cc488322fb7d9bb047e8894a55a865ffc613817b25.png] 

The next step will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1c3bc52e7ff122f86569b4a45650efc98594e882f376997744a0b127aaaca0f.png]
